newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen says another state probes merger.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says another state probes merger.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc said on Monday Pennsylvania's Attorney General is investigating Service Corp International's $2.9 billion proposed acquisition of Loewen.

In a letter to Loewen Group, an antitrust official from the state's attorney general office indicated concern about the potential anticompetitive impact the proposed deal may have in Pennsylvania, Loewen said.
Loewen had rebuffed a hostile takeover bid by Service Corp and urged its shareholders not to tender their shares, the company said in a statement on October 10.
Loewen said the letter also indicated that the state Attorney General's office was "very interested in coordinating its investigation with any investigation that may be conducted by the FTC."
Service Corp's offer is being examined by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and Florida officials, as well as other states, Loewen said.
Service Corp officials were not immediately available for comment.
A merger would link Service Corp, North America's largest funeral home and cemetery operator, with its closest competitor.
Loewen said it filed an antitrust lawsuit against Service Corp last week.
